name: fix75_block_lag
verifies: fix-75 #3: the block during an attack comes up as soon as G3 allows (the running Hit ends; G3 never cuts a running Raise/Hit: OnPlayerSecondaryAction only queues Parade), replaces a clicked follow-up attack (one-slot queue), is never lost, comes back after a block-held quick attack while the key stays down (G3 FUN_10002130) and stays up while held
notes: 1H Attack: Hit ends 533 ms after the start (speed 0.6), so a block pressed 100 ms in is up after ~430-450 ms, 400 ms in after ~130-150 ms; from rest 67 ms (ResponsivenessTests). blocklag fails over max= ms, when a move starts after the block press (the queued combo attack must be replaced) or when the parade drops while held.
